title.zh: 日本互联网巨头遭攻击，黑客勒索比特币，公司负责人拒付赎金
title.en: 日本互联网巨头遭攻击，黑客勒索比特币，公司负责人拒付赎金

current_state.zh: GMO Group's cloud desktop service suffered unauthorized access affecting up to 26,739 servers, with hackers demanding Bitcoin and Ethereum ransom that GMO's president refused to pay while GMO Coin confirmed no customer account anomalies.
